visual_review.method: Manual inspection of one fixed prompt/seed; not a general quality evaluation.

sdturbo-baseline-512-4.note: Visually inspected: nearly uniform brown/noise; the old V-prediction override is incorrect for this checkpoint.

sdturbo-vulkan-eps-512-4.note: Visually inspected: recognizable red teapot, table and window; discrete schedule, four steps.

sdturbo-cpu-eps-512-4.note: Visually inspected: recognizable red teapot, similar composition to matching Vulkan run; warmer device.

matrix-sd-turbo-cpu-4.note: Visually inspected: red teapot and cup on wooden surface by a window; trailing schedule.

matrix-sd-turbo-vulkan-4.note: Visually inspected: same recognizable teapot/cup/window composition as the matching CPU trailing-schedule image; minor pixel differences.

matrix-sd15-cpu-4.note: Valid inference output, but four Euler-A steps are insufficient: recognizable red teapot shape is blurred and lacks detail. Do not compare this as converged quality.

matrix-sd15-vulkan-4.note: Visually inspected: blurred red teapot and window, similar to matching CPU sample. Four Euler-A steps are insufficient for SD1.5 quality.

matrix-sdxl-base-cpu-4.note: Visually inspected: blurred red/black teapot silhouette by a window. Four Euler-A steps at 512 square are not a converged SDXL quality sample.

matrix-sdxl-base-vulkan-4.note: Visually inspected: same blurred teapot/window composition as matching CPU output. Valid inference, insufficient four-step SDXL quality.

matrix-sdxl-turbo-cpu-4.note: Visually inspected: detailed red teapot, cup, table and window in warm light. Stylized/painterly despite photographic prompt; no broad quality ranking inferred.

matrix-sdxl-turbo-vulkan-4.note: Visually inspected: detailed teapot/cup/window scene closely matching the CPU sample, with minor pixel differences; stylized rendering.

sdturbo-gpu-1.note: Visually inspected: red teapot scene by window. Composition differs from four steps; extra-spout-like detail and small pot/cup geometry show that one step is a quality/latency choice, not equivalent quality.

sdturbo-gpu-2.note: Visually inspected: recognizable teapot/cup/window; cleaner spout geometry than the one-step sample for this fixed prompt. Single-prompt inspection does not establish general quality equivalence to four steps.

sdturbo-f16-gpu-1.note: Visually inspected: closely matches original one-step scene including extra-spout-like artifact; precision conversion does not establish improved image quality.

sdturbo-no-fa-1.note: Visually inspected: closely matches flash-attention one-step scene, including the extra-spout-like detail; no meaningful visual improvement established.

sdturbo-preview-1.note: Visually inspected: recognizable matching teapot/window scene; changed saturation, fine texture and edge rendering versus full VAE. TAESD is a deliberate approximate-decoder tradeoff, not equivalent quality.

sdturbo-tiling-1.note: Visually inspected: matching one-step composition with softer/different texture; no obvious large tile-boundary break in this sample. Tiling quality and peak-memory savings are not generally established by one image.

sdturbo-resident-1.note: All three downloaded PNGs have the identical SHA-256 of the visually reviewed sdturbo-gpu-1 image. Same image/one-step artifacts; residency changes do not alter this fixed-seed result.

sd15-f16-gpu-4.note: Visually inspected: same blurred teapot composition as original-precision four-step SD1.5; changing precision does not fix insufficient sampling.

sdxl-turbo-gpu-1.note: Visually inspected: recognizable teapot/cup/window, but patchy geometric texture and rough detail compared with four-step Q4 output. Do not present one-step Q4 as equivalent-quality photography.

z-image-turbo-bounded-256-1.note: Visually inspected: rough blurred red teapot at 256x256. One step is a diagnostic only; Z-Image-Turbo recommends eight steps and this is not a completed quality benchmark.

z-image-turbo-bounded-no-fa-256-1.note: Visually inspected: similarly blurred 256x256 teapot to flash-attention probe; one step is insufficient for this model, and attention change does not resolve the latency limitation.

final-sdturbo-balanced-2.note: Downloaded PNG SHA-256 independently verified identical to the visually reviewed sdturbo-gpu-2 image. Final APK with GPU source-weight residency and full VAE preserves this fixed-seed two-step image.
